title: Console: reloading with a related-record form open puts the record side panel on top of the form dialog, hiding its fields and the 创建 button
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible, reproducible).
reach: public entry — the console in a browser (Playwright, zh-CN, 1440×900), measured on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).

## Business reason

A person who refreshes (or follows a shared link) while adding an expense line cannot finish: the right half of the form, the upload area and the 创建 button sit under the record panel.

## Steps

1. Open a parent record (报销单) in its side panel, 报销明细 tab, 新建. The URL becomes `…/k7en_claim?recordId=…&related=k7en_claim_line.claim_ref&form=new&formObject=k7en_claim_line&formLink=claim_ref%3A…`. The dialog renders above the panel (correct).
2. Reload that URL (or open it directly).

## What happens

Both the side panel and the 新建报销明细 dialog open, with the panel stacked above the dialog: the dialog's right column (费用日期, 金额, 电子发票) and its 创建 button are covered; clicks land on the panel's overlay ("`<div data-state="open" … fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80>` intercepts pointer events"). Closing and reopening the form from the panel works.

## Expected

The form dialog opened by `form=new` stacks above the record panel, as it does when opened by clicking.

Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` seat (record panel / form dialog stacking in `ui/apps/console`).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue form=new record panel overlay dialog` → 32 hits (#30039, #26843, #29172), none on this stacking.
